title: Amgros — Denmark buys its hospital medicines through one body owned by the regions

CZ CHECK, AND IT IS NOT AN ABSENCE. Czech queries run 2026-09-03: 'dynamický nákupní systém léčiv', 'sdružený nákup léků nemocnice', 'centrální nákup léčiv nemocnice', 'sdružené nákupy nemocnic'. title: Trulla — pharmacy procurement software bought by a healthcare spend firm four years after founding
money_note: Acquisition price not disclosed in the 16 August 2022 release and no figure is estimated. SpendMend was itself backed by Morgan Stanley Capital Partners from early 2022; that investment amount is likewise not published here.
summary: Trulla, founded in 2018 in Draper, Utah by a former Intermountain Healthcare pharmacy sourcing executive, sells cloud software that lets a hospital system run pharmacy ordering, pricing algorithms, product standardisation and supplier selection across all its sites, and was acquired by SpendMend in August 2022. It is the buyer-side product a Czech hospital pharmacy running a dynamic purchasing system per therapeutic group does not have.
notes: PREFIX: 'us' is NOT in arb-scan's id_prefixes in data/feeds.json and must be added before this record is appended — see 'Registry changes needed' in manifest-sweep.md. TRANSFER LOGIC: the Czech pattern is one hospital, many parallel dynamic purchasing systems split by ATC group, each run by hand off the hospital's e-procurement profile; Trulla is the layer that makes that ordering and price comparison a workflow rather than a procurement filing. Traction stated in the release: 'In the last year, we've provided compliance and optimization services for over 300 pharmacies'; a later SpendMend release claims over 250m USD of drug-cost savings delivered, and Froedtert Health adopted it in June 2024. CZ CHECK, AND IT IS NOT AN ABSENCE FOR THE TENDERING TOOL. Czech queries run 2026-09-03: 'software pro nákup léčiv nemocnice', 'nemocniční lékárna objednávání léčiv software', 'dynamický nákupní systém léčiv elektronický nástroj'. Surfaces checked: google-cz, own-funded-ledger. FOUND: PROEBIZ (JOSEPHINE, TENDERBOX), QCM's E-ZAK and Tender arena all run Czech hospital dynamic purchasing systems today; Medicalc sells hospital information systems. What was NOT found is a Czech product doing pharmacy-side price optimisation and supplier selection across a hospital group's sites.
